page_title: LYO 0-3 LEN | Lyon v Lens 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

90+4' Facundo Medina (Lens) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the top of the net, but Anthony Lopes made a superb athletic save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Lens will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+3' Lens control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

90+1' Wesley Said swings in an inviting cross that finds Florian Sotoca (Lens). He doesn't take advantage as his effort goes harmlessly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

87' 0 - 3 Kevin Danso (Lens) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 0:3.
87' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Jonathan Gradit and he is replaced by Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens).
87' Lens force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
86' What a chance to score from the free kick by Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens). He unleashed a sharp shot that sailed just wide of the right post.
86' Ernest Nuamah will be replaced by Clinton Mata (Lyon).
86' Lens have a free kick from a promising distance.
84' We have witnessed a red card for Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon).

84' Jake O'Brien (Lyon) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
83' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Kevin Danso (Lens), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
82' Brice Samba (Lens) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
80' Brice Samba (Lens) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
79' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the middle of the goal, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Brice Samba. What a save!
79' Jake O'Brien (Lyon) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
79' The ball is out of play and Lyon manage to earn a corner.
79' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Elye Wahi leaves the pitch to be replaced by Wesley Said (Lens).
78' Malick Fofana (Lyon) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Brice Samba.
78' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
77' Substitution. Mama Balde (Lyon) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Said Benrahma walks off.
75' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and David Pereira da Costa departs the field of play to be replaced by Adrien Thomasson (Lens).
73' Here is a change. Nampalys Mendy is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Salis Abdul Samed (Lens).
73' Said Benrahma (Lyon) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
72' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Lyon have been awarded a free kick.
70' Florian Sotoca (Lens) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
69' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) tries to find Nicolas Tagliafico, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
68' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
66' A pass into the box finds Ruben Aguilar (Lens) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the roof of the net, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Anthony Lopes denies him.
66' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
65' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
64' Elye Wahi (Lens) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
63' A pass by Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
61' Pierre Sage has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Malick Fofana (Lyon) replacing Orel Mangala.
61' Here's the change. Gift Orban leaves the pitch and Rayan Cherki (Lyon) comes on as a substitute.
58' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) was too forceful with his tackle and Jerome Brisard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
56' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
54' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
53' 0 - 2 Goal! Elye Wahi (Lens) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Anthony Lopes into the bottom left corner.
53' Elye Wahi (Lens) is going to take the penalty!
52' The Lens players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

51' Play continues despite the shouts by some Lens players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Jerome Brisard interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
50' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
48' Gift Orban (Lyon) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

45' Said Benrahma (Lyon) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
43' 0 - 1 Goal! David Pereira da Costa picks out Florian Sotoca (Lens) with a perfect cross, and he has no problem to nod the ball into an empty net. It's 0:1.
42' Florian Sotoca (Lens) fires a powerful volley towards goal, but his shot lacks accuracy and is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
41' Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Nampalys Mendy (Lens) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
38' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

38' Anthony Lopes was forced into action to thwart Elye Wahi (Lens). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
36' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

33' A precise low pass is received by Said Benrahma (Lyon), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
31' Said Benrahma (Lyon) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
29' Said Benrahma (Lyon) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Good work from Lyon as they win a corner.
29' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) picks up a yellow card.

24' Nice individual effort by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon). He gets all the way to the goalkeeper, produces a strike towards the roof of the net, but Brice Samba does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out with a save.
23' Flag up against Ernest Nuamah (Lyon). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
23' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
22' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
19' Facundo Medina (Lens) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
18' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
16' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon).

14' OFF THE POST! Orel Mangala (Lyon) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
14' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
13' Jake O'Brien (Lyon) jumps highest to head the ball from the resulting free kick on the edge of the box! A difficult position to score from and the keeper reacts coolly to make a comfortable save.
11' Florian Sotoca (Lens) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Anthony Lopes intercepts the ball.
10' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
9' Said Benrahma (Lyon) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
7' Elye Wahi (Lens) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the bottom of the right post is denied by a decent save from Anthony Lopes.
5' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
2' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Lyon will take the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
